problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained differentiable objectives f: ℝ → ℝ, permitting nonconvexity. A global lower bound ℓ exists with f(x0) − ℓ ≤ Δ; attainment of the infimum is not required.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: A query x returns only g(x, ξ), with fresh IID seeds and E[g(x, ξ)] = f′(x). The oracle is jointly measurable and integrable. All parameters H, ν, Δ, σ, p, ε, x0 are public; f and the oracle distribution are hidden. Oracle cost is a fixed budget counting every individual gradient reply, including batch samples.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ScalarHolderStochastic.lean: spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.Query, spec.Reply, spec.admissible, IsGradientOracle; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID; LongTails/Template.lean: execute and Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: Global Hölder continuity of the derivative: |f′(x) − f′(y)| ≤ H|x − y|^ν, with H > 0 and 0 < ν ≤ 1.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniform central moment bound E[|g(x, ξ) − f′(x)|^p] ≤ σ^p, with 1 < p ≤ 2 and σ ≥ 0. Finite variance is not required when p < 2.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The domain, gradient replies, and output are scalar real numbers; dimension is exactly one.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Oracle seeds are independent and identically distributed across calls; adaptively chosen query points share no reusable sample access.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ScalarHolderStochastic.lean: spec.admissible oracle construction; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID.independent and IID.marginal; LongTails/Template.lean: execute.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: Return a measurable scalar output X satisfying |f′(X)| ≤ ε; the criterion uses the absolute derivative, without squaring, and imposes no particular iterate selection.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: P(|f′(X)| > ε) ≤ 1/3, hence success probability at least 2/3, over the joint algorithm and oracle randomness.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ScalarHolderStochastic.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence joint product probability law.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines unrestricted scalar nonconvex stationarity, global Hölder derivative regularity, and IID unbiased noise controlled only by a central p-th moment. This is a meaningful specialized variant of standard stochastic stationarity benchmarks.

descriptionHtml:
Scalar Hölder Stochastic Stationarity

We consider a differentiable, possibly nonconvex function f:R→R with a globally Hölder continuous derivative. A given point x0∈R has objective gap at most Δ>0 above a global lower bound. At x, the oracle returns an unbiased scalar estimate of f′(x) using a fresh independent sample; its error has uniformly bounded pth absolute moment for 1<p≤2, allowing heavy-tailed noise. For ε>0, the goal is a measurable output x¯∈R satisfying P(|f′(x¯)|>ε)≤1/3, where P is the joint law of the samples and the algorithm’s independent randomness.

The underlying optimization problem is infx∈Rf(x), with accuracy measured by stationarity. Fix a measurable sample space Ω and parameters H>0,0<ν≤1,Δ>0,σ≥0,1<p≤2,ε>0. The algorithm receives Ω, H, ν, Δ, σ, p, ε, and x0; the objective and sampling distribution are accessed through the oracle.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Hölder continuity). The function f is differentiable everywhere, and |f′(x)−f′(y)|≤H|x−y|ν,x,y∈R.

Assumption 2 (Lower bound and initial gap). There exists ℓ∈R such that ℓ≤f(x)for every x∈R,f(x0)−ℓ≤Δ.

Assumption 3 (Independent stochastic derivative oracle). There exist a probability measure μ on Ω and a jointly measurable function g:R×Ω→R. For each x∈R, both g(x,⋅) and |g(x,⋅)−f′(x)|p are integrable under μ, and Eξ∼μ[g(x,ξ)]=f′(x),Eξ∼μ[|g(x,ξ)−f′(x)|p]≤σp. At call k≥0, a query x∈R receives the scalar reply g(x,ξk). The samples (ξk)k≥0 are measurable, mutually independent, and each has law μ. The algorithm’s randomness is independent of the entire sample sequence.

Queries may be made at any point of R. After the allotted oracle calls, the output x¯ must be measurable and satisfy P(|f′(x¯)|>ε)≤13.

comparisonHtml:
Differentiable f:R→R satisfies |f′(x)−f′(y)|≤H|x−y|ν and f≥flow with f(x0)−flow≤Δ. Here H,Δ,ε>0, 0<ν≤1, σ≥0, and 1<p≤2. A jointly measurable oracle g has integrable values and central pth moments, ∫g(x,ω)dμ=f′(x) and ∫|g(x,ω)−f′(x)|pdμ≤σp. Samples are IID with law μ under a probability measure P. Target: measurable X with P(|f′(X)|>ε)≤1/3.

Scalar stochastic stationarity under a Hölder derivative: ScalarHolderStochastic.

import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

namespace LongTails.Setups.ScalarHolderStochastic

open OracleTemplate

structure Params where
  Ω : Type
  [measurableΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  H : ℝ
  ν : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  σ : ℝ
  p : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  x0 : ℝ

attribute [instance] Params.measurableΩ

structure IsGradientOracle {Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (g : ℝ → Ω → ℝ) (σ p : ℝ) : Prop where
  measurable : Measurable (Function.uncurry g)
  integrable : ∀ x, Integrable (g x) μ
  unbiased : ∀ x, ∫ ω, g x ω ∂μ = deriv f x
  moment_integrable : ∀ x, Integrable (fun ω => |g x ω - deriv f x| ^ p) μ
  moment : ∀ x, (∫ ω, |g x ω - deriv f x| ^ p ∂μ) ≤ σ ^ p

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance _ := ℝ → ℝ
  Query _ := ℝ
  Reply _ := ℝ
  Output _ := ℝ
  publicInput p := p
  valid q := 0 < q.H ∧ 0 < q.ν ∧ q.ν ≤ 1 ∧ 0 < q.Δ ∧
    0 ≤ q.σ ∧ 1 < q.p ∧ q.p ≤ 2 ∧ 0 < q.ε
  admissible q f O :=
    ∃ (g : ℝ → q.Ω → ℝ) (μ : ProbabilityMeasure q.Ω)
        (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → q.Ω)),
      LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k (ξ : ℕ → q.Ω) => ξ k) (μ : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
      O = { Seed := fun _ => q.Ω
            law := P
            answer := fun _ (_, x) ω => g x ω } ∧
      (∀ x, HasDerivAt f (deriv f x) x) ∧
      (∀ x y, |deriv f x - deriv f y| ≤ q.H * |x - y| ^ q.ν) ∧
      (∃ lower, (∀ x, lower ≤ f x) ∧ f q.x0 - lower ≤ q.Δ) ∧
      IsGradientOracle (μ : Measure _) f g q.σ q.p
  successful q f output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
      (P : Measure _) {ω | q.ε < |deriv f (output ω)|} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 3 : ℝ)

end LongTails.Setups.ScalarHolderStochastic
